column_semantics: The March 31, 2026 schedule uses an All-in Rate column for the stated position rate, with separate Ref. Rate, Spread, and PIK (z) columns. Footnote (z) states that the difference between the All-In Rate and PIK Rate is the cash rate, so the stated All-in Rate includes PIK.

citations.quote: Investments may have a portion, or all, of their income received from Paid-in-Kind ("PIK") interest or dividends. PIK interest income and cumulative dividend income represent income not paid currently in cash. The difference between the All-In Rate and PIK Rate represents the cash rate as of March 31, 2026.

rationale: The filing is explicit: position-level stated rates are labeled All-in Rate, and footnote (z) says cash rate equals All-In Rate minus PIK Rate. The sample PIK rows confirm the same structure by printing an all-in rate and a separate PIK column, rather than using the stated rate as cash-only.
